writing: Introduce one specific claim as a misconception or question, never assert it as truth. Correct it using source-linked claims, explain the boundary and give a concrete example. Use a comparison with Myth/Fact headings and exact claim/correction phrases. Do not invent a universally held belief or overstate evidence. End with the supported correction.
visuals: Original trusted graphic on EVERY unit: callout, process or exact-phrase comparison. Show the concrete question/example immediately, without a generic title card. For quiz_pause exactly one timer scene repeats the earlier question and precedes the answer. Do not request stock, fabricated interfaces, real-person images or screenshots as evidence.
sound: Retain the accepted clear education voice. Optional bounded internal silence/speed uses speech_segments.
description: One sourced misconception and a concrete bounded correction
task: Write ONLY the story/content script first. hook must be the exact first spoken unit, not a stronger unwritten marketing summary. The first words must establish the specific curiosity/problem. The actual answer must occupy the final or penultimate unit with no filler ending; edit.payoff_unit_id identifies it. Do not plan an unsupported edit or choose unverified asset URLs. The separate director call will preserve these exact words.
editorial_policy: New playbook batches generate three typed hooks in the same writing call and request a separate exact-payoff review. Comment prompts are optional and follow the delivered answer. Clean dialogue never contains speech-control markup. Director speech_segments can express bounded pace/internal silence without changing words. Source clips and caption-led aura keep their separate contracts.
retention_note: Patterns are testable editorial hypotheses, not a retention guarantee.
